definitions.gloss: to remove, to get rid of

definitions.explanation: To leave out from a group.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を除いて{全員|ぜんいん}

notes:
{除|のぞ}く means to remove, exclude, or eliminate something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the thing being removed or excluded

HOMOPHONE ALERT:
- {除|のぞ}く (this word): to remove, exclude
- {覗|のぞ}く: to peek, peep (different kanji and meaning)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{除|のぞ}いて: excluding ~, except for ~
- 〜を{除|のぞ}く: to remove ~
- 〜を{除|のぞ}けば: if we exclude ~

EXAMPLE CONTEXTS:
- {汚|よご}れを{除|のぞ}く: to remove dirt
- {例外|れいがい}を{除|のぞ}く: to exclude exceptions
- {彼|かれ}を{除|のぞ}いて{全員|ぜんいん}: everyone except him
